checks: Nested deadline cannot expand parent; exceptions restore prior deadline; thread context stays isolated

UTF-8 response byte boundary accepted at 16382 and rejected at 16385 bytes
gzip/br/multiple encodings refused before stream iteration or decompression
DNS timeout returns before late worker completion; late worker never sends; a new request succeeds independently
Malformed execution receipt yields unknown with reserved risk budget; idempotent retry does not execute again; only valid read-only reconciliation settles budget
limits: No production network, formal MCP conformance certification or real DNS resolver reliability claim.
